request: Assess the supplied item handlers against the accepted original policy and request a change that preserves owner-only access for authenticated non-superusers while allowing authenticated active superusers to read or modify any item.

policySources.text: An authenticated non-superuser may read or modify only items they own. An authenticated active superuser may read or modify an item regardless of owner.
